nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util¶

Shared helpers for qvtpy stages (import submodules explicitly).

Layout (by pipeline domain):

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.io — paths, SGE, cluster/XNAT upload, QC reports

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab — eICAB masks/postprocess, brain mask, morpho paths

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.centerline — centerline I/O, venous, flow masks, cleaning

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.segmentation — stage-4 vessel CD segmentation helpers

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.loc — LOC selection and LOC measurements

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.hemodynamics — PITC/PWV, plots, viz bundle, measure QC
